title: GesaPlugin
description: GesaPlugin is a powerful tool for creating, editing, and animating custom particle zones in Minecraft. It allows players to visually build effects, manage animation frames, and fine-tune particle settings using intuitive commands and tools.
body:
📦 GesaPlugin — Advanced Particle Zone & Animation Tool for Minecraft

GesaPlugin is a Minecraft Spigot plugin designed to create and manage fully customizable particle zones. Its purpose is to give players, builders, and map creators an intuitive visual tool for placing, editing, and animating particles directly inside the game world.

With GesaPlugin, players can create zones, add or remove particle points, adjust RGB particle colors, and build multi-frame animations that can be played, paused, or edited at any moment. Special wands let users interact with zones naturally through simple right-click actions.

✨ How to Use Create or select a zone

📝 Command: /gesa <name> Creates or selects a GESA zone and makes it your active zone.

Get a tool (wand)

🪄 Command: /gsssda <proj|sest|gsgsa>

Wand Purpose PROJ Add new particle points SEST Edit or adjust points GSGSA Delete the nearest particle point Add or remove particles

🖱️ Right-click with your wand:

PROJ — adds a new particle point

GSGSA — removes the nearest point within 2 blocks

Change your particle color

🎨 Command: /gsa <R> <G> Values must be from 0.0 to 1.0

RGB color generator: https://orkm5516-dot.github.io/GSA-RGB-Generator.github.io/

Create animations

🎞️ Commands:

/animatic <zone> <frame> — switch or create a frame

/animatic start <zone> — start animation playback

/animatic stop <zone> — stop animation

/animatic del <zone> — delete all frames of the zone

Clear the zone

🧹 Command: /gss_clear Removes all particles and all animation frames in your active zone.

Get command help

❓ Command: /gss Shows a list of all GesaPlugin commands.

🌐 System Language

Command: /system <eng|rus>

Changes the plugin’s interface language between English and Russian.
